name: 01-main-desktop-mobile
prompt: Create a TripLOG travel-tools UI mockup showing a desktop screen and a 390px mobile screen side by side. Render Korean interface text. Use the existing app language: white surfaces, dark navy thin outlines and text, yellow primary actions, pale blue secondary controls, restrained pink accents, small offset shadows, rounded corners. Keep typography compact and moderate in weight, with natural colorful category icons and no extra inner icon boxes. Header: TripLOG. Compact shared trip context: 가을 도쿄 여행, 11.03–11.07 · 4박 5일. Tabs: 오늘의 여행, 예약 지갑, 여행 도구; 여행 도구 selected. Page title 여행 도구. Show exactly seven independent compact tools: 준비물 with a 3/7 progress indicator; 여행지 시간대 with 도쿄 · Asia/Tokyo; 캘린더 파일 with .ics and 저장; 일출·일몰 with 도쿄, sunrise 06:06 and sunset 16:44; 한국 ↔ 현지 시간 with 서울 ↔ 도쿄; Wi-Fi 공유 QR with a Wi-Fi/QR icon; 단위 변환 with °C↔°F · km↔mi · kg↔lb. Use a balanced desktop grid and a readable mobile two-column arrangement, allowing the packing progress row to span both columns. Keep actions visually consistent and give the seven tools equal access priority. No photos, oversized hero, long prose, extra features or large ornamental illustrations. Bottom navigation: 개요, 일정, 여행, 지출, 리포트; 여행 active, all five icons and labels uniformly aligned.

name: 02-existing-tools-details
prompt: Create three adjacent 390px mobile detail-screen mockups for TripLOG: 준비물, 여행지 시간대, 캘린더 파일. Use one coherent existing component system: white surfaces, dark navy fine outlines, yellow primary buttons, pale blue secondary buttons, restrained pink accents, small offset shadows, compact moderate-weight Korean typography. Each panel uses the same TripLOG dialog header, close X, input radius, dropdown style and footer button geometry. No extra icon boxes, photos or decorative hero. 준비물: show a small 3/7 progress visualization, a new-item field with plus action, compact shared checkbox rows; 여권, eSIM, 충전기 checked; 보조배터리, 상비약, 접이식 우산, 엔화 현금 unchecked. Keep edit and delete affordances small. 여행지 시간대: a common city/timezone dropdown set to 도쿄 / Asia/Tokyo, compact current local time preview, a short note 오늘의 여행과 캘린더에 적용, and yellow 적용. This sets the trip timezone and is not the time converter. 캘린더 파일: compact trip context 가을 도쿄 여행, 11.03–11.07, Asia/Tokyo; shared options 전체 일정 / 날짜 선택, a short preview of timed itinerary rows, a small .ics file row, and yellow 캘린더 파일 저장. Clearly present a downloaded calendar file, not a live account connection. Keep all three details practical, compact and visually related to the main app.

name: 03-sun-and-time-details
prompt: Create two adjacent 390px mobile TripLOG detail-screen mockups: 일출·일몰 and 한국 ↔ 현지 시간. Follow the existing app component language: white background, navy outlines and text, yellow main actions, pale blue secondary controls, restrained pink, small offset shadows, rounded shared inputs and date selectors. Compact moderate-weight Korean typography, clear visual hierarchy, natural icons without inner bordered boxes. 일출·일몰: common city selector 도쿄, common date control 11.03 (화), a simple daylight arc with sun icon, two compact result blocks 일출 06:06 and 일몰 16:44, daylight duration 낮 길이 10시간 38분, and a small countdown 일몰까지 2시간 14분 based on a displayed sample local time 14:30. Treat this as city/date astronomy, with no weather, forecast, moon or live-service features. 한국 ↔ 현지 시간: two linked city controls 서울 / 뉴욕 with a compact swap button; shared date/time inputs set to 서울 11.03 (화) 09:00; a clearly readable result 뉴욕 11.02 (월) 19:00 with a small 전날 indicator and -14시간 offset. Date and weekday change must be visually obvious. Do not confuse this with changing the trip timezone. Each panel has the same TripLOG closeable detail header and consistent control sizes.

name: 04-wifi-and-units-details
prompt: Create two adjacent 390px mobile TripLOG detail-screen mockups: Wi-Fi 공유 QR and 단위 변환. Match the existing app system with white surfaces, dark navy fine outlines and text, yellow main buttons, pale blue secondary controls, restrained pink accents, compact rounded inputs, small offset shadows and moderate-weight Korean typography. Use natural colorful icons without separate inner bordered squares. Wi-Fi 공유 QR: shared fields 네트워크 이름 with fictional SSID TripLOG_Guest, 비밀번호 with masked characters and an eye control, 보안 dropdown WPA/WPA2, a compact generated QR preview, yellow QR 만들기 action, and a small local-only hint 이 기기에서만 생성. Keep it a Wi-Fi network-sharing tool, not a map QR, upload flow, account service or saved-password manager. 단위 변환: shared segmented category tabs 온도 / 거리 / 무게, 온도 selected; input 68 with °F dropdown, compact swap-direction control, and prominent but restrained result 20 °C. Include compact secondary examples 10 mi ≈ 16.09 km and 10 lb ≈ 4.54 kg. A small destination selector 미국 sets suitable default units. Keep numerical alignment precise and keypad-friendly controls clear. No currency, price comparison, clothing sizes, fees or additional tools. Both panels use the same TripLOG closeable detail header and footer spacing.
